title: Pool Chem Log: Water Tests
short_description: Log pool and spa water tests and get FC/CYA dosing for chlorine, pH and more.

guides.title: FC/CYA Chart for Pool Chlorine Levels
guides.description: The FC/CYA chart as a table: minimum, target, SLAM and mustard chlorine levels for every CYA from 0 to 100 ppm, with a worked example.

guides.title: Pool CSI Calculator: Saturation Index Explained
guides.description: Calculate the calcite saturation index (CSI) of your pool water with the full formula, a worked example, and what to change when it is off.

guides.title: Pool Volume Calculator: Gallons by Shape
guides.description: Calculate pool volume in gallons or liters for rectangle, round, oval, kidney and freeform pools, with the formulas and worked examples.
